requirements:
This is a model of Video Stores.
There are also clients and movies in the system, all of which (video stores, clients and movies) have a
name. Video stores rent out movies, where the same movie can be offered in any video store. Video stores have clients. The same client can be a client of several video stores.

issues.message: The intermediate model does not accurately represent the relationships between classes as described in the PlantUML diagram.
issues.evidence: The requirements state that a video store can rent out movies, where the same movie can be offered in any video store. The PlantUML diagram shows a multiplicity of one for the 'rent' relationship, which contradicts this requirement.
suggestions: Update the intermediate model to reflect the correct relationships between classes as described in the PlantUML diagram.
